newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Updated details of Russian Eurobond issues.
newsitem.headline: Updated details of Russian Eurobond issues.

text.p: Nizhny Novgorod said it would issue a Eurobond in September.
Sibneft increased the size of its FRN by $25 million to $150 million.
ISSUED:
SIBNEFT - Aug 1997; $150 million FRN; Aug 15, 2000; Salomon Brothers; four percentage points over LIBOR.
UNEXIMBANK - July 1997; $200 million; 3 yrs; Aug 1, 2000; 400 bp over three-year U.S. Treasuries; coupon 9.875 pct; issue/reoffer prices 99.81 pct; Merrill Lynch/ICFI (MFK); IBCA BB; Moody's Ba3;

ALFA-BANK - July 16, 1997; $175 million; July 28, 2000; 475 bp over 6.375 pct May 2000 U.S. Treasuries; issue price is 99.625 pct; coupon 10.375 pct; Goldman Sachs; Moody's B1, Standard & Poor's single B, IBCA BB minus.

SBS-AGRO (STOLICHNY BANK SBEREGENY) - July 8, 1997; $200 million; 3 yrs; July 21, 2000; priced to yield 425 bp 6.375 U.S. Treasuries (May 2000); coupon 10.25 pct; re-offer price 99.25 pct; JP Morgan Securities; July 10, 1997-additional tranche; $50 million; priced to yield 420 bp over 6.375 May 2000 U.S Treasuries; Moody's B1, S&P B+, IBCA long-term BB.

RUSSIAN FEDERATION - June 1997; $2.0 bln; June 26, 2007; priced to yield 375 bp over 6.625 pct U.S Treasuries (May 15, 2007); annual coupon 10.00 pct; re-offer price is 99.164 pct; JP Morgan Securities/SBC Warburg

ST PETERSBURG - June 1997; $300 million; May 2002; priced to yield 312.5 bp over five-year U.S. Treasuries (May 2002); Salomon Brothers; coupon 9.50 pct; S&P BB-, IBCA BB+; IBCA rated the issue at BB+, S&P BB-

CITY OF MOSCOW - May 1997, $500 million May 2000; priced to yield 315 bp over 6.375 pct three-year U.S Treasuries (May 2000); CS First Boston/Nomura International; coupon 9.50 pct; Moody's Ba2, Standard & Poor's BB-

RUSSIAN FEDERATION - March 1997; 2.0 bln marks; 7 yrs (maturing March 25, 2004); Deutsche Morgan Grenfell/ CS First Boston; coupon 9.0 pct, priced to yield 370 bp over seven-year (March 2004) German government bonds; S&P BB-

RUSSIAN FEDERATION - November 1996, $1 bln; 5 yrs (maturing November 27, 2001); JP Morgan/SBC Warburg; coupon 9.25 pct, priced to yield 345 bp over five-year U.S. Treasuries (5.875 pct notes due November 30, 2001); Moody's Ba2, S&P BB-, IBCA BB+
PLANNED:
SOVEREIGN

RUSSIAN FEDERATION - may decide not to issue another Eurobond in 1997; up to $3.5 bln in total 1997 borrowing; plans to apply for permission to make a global bond issue this autumn, likely to be dollar-denominated; dealers estimated the volume to be between $500 million and $1.0 bln
RUSSIAN FEDERATION - rouble Eurobond in 1998
RUSSIAN FEDERATION - $3.0-$3.5 bln through three Eurobond issues in 1998. One issue likely to be yen-denominated.
